title: 500 public API services for AURA Desk
scope: 500 distinct service discoveries, not 500 field presets or pre-validated firmware integrations.
verification_notes: Directory-reported no-auth/free access is a discovery claim, not provider confirmation.
Documentation HEAD checks used normal TLS; redirects were allowed for documentation, not for API firmware requests.
Provider documentation review and any live endpoint checks are recorded separately on individual records.
No full firmware integration or all-500 live endpoint verification has been performed.
Current firmware requires direct HTTPS 200 GET JSON, no auth headers, URL <=200 bytes, body <=32768 bytes, short scalar <=47 bytes, refresh >=300 seconds.
One service may offer many readings. No coin/country/field variants were used to reach the 500 count.

On 2026-10-04, one Meteo.lt reading was added and the unavailable Jacobbrewer1 F1 service slot was explicitly replaced with Jolpica plus a bounded standings reading. Original discovery evidence and dates are retained; exact fresh profile evidence is in PUBLIC_API_SERVICE_READINGS.json.
